description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the BackendApi class, which acts as a minimal backend integration layer for a sports live score and news platform. It provides placeholder methods for health checks, login, signup, fetching live matches, upcoming matches, and news, with some methods returning mock data.

classes.name: BackendApi
classes.description: A class providing minimal methods to interact with a backend API related to sports live scores and news.

methods.name: healthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check by calling the backend's GET '/' endpoint and returns success or failure.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Placeholder method to perform login, currently always fails with an UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Placeholder method for user signup, currently always fails with an UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: getLiveMatches
methods.description: Returns mocked list of live match strings until backend endpoint is available.

methods.name: getUpcomingMatches
methods.description: Returns mocked list of upcoming match strings.

methods.name: getNews
methods.description: Returns mocked list of news headlines.
